games.name: [RELEASE🌟] Crawl
games.desc:
This is a challenging game. You have been warned.

⚔️  Once abandoned by your own ambition, you now have one last chance to rise. Descend into ruthless dungeons, crafting your power from the bones of your enemies. Survive relentless bosses, forge legendary weapons, and shape your destiny. But remember—before you walk, you must first learn to crawl.

Update 2.0.0

🏰 IRON CITADEL
- Explore the newest Crawl dungeon with 13 new spells, 12 new armor sets, and 33 legendary weapons to acquire!
- Will you prevail?  Or will you succumb to the horrors that await inside the Iron Citadel?

💍 RINGS
- Unlock rings starting at level 5.
- Rings unlock Ring abilities which allow for unique abilities that enhance your gameplay.

 💫 QUALITY OF LIFE
- Many optimization and bug fixes.
- Inventory sort option.
- Many more features.

🏵 BALANCING
- Nerfs to Ancient Shrine and Volcanic Mines.
- Increases to their EXP drop as well.

Tags: RPG, Magic, Dungeon, Adventure, Quest, Action, Bosses

[THIS GAME ACTIVELY OPENS FOR STRESS TESTS EVERY NOW AND THEN, IT IS STILL NOT FULLY RELEASED AND MANY THINGS ARE SUBJECT TO CHANGE]

Sorcery is an open world PVP and PVE oriented game.

Controls:
Q - Dodge, Flashstep while charging your Cursed Energy
F - Parry, Block
E - Charge your Cursed Energy Output; cursed techniques require cursed energy to be used
R - Critical Attack
CTRL + Left Click - Uptilt
N - Sense (when used while charging your Cursed Energy, you are able to sense cursed energy near you)
RIGHT CLICK - Execute knocked enemies
Crouch + Right Click - Stealth Takedown (must be behind the enemy)
Left Control - Crouch
Left Alt - Shift Lock
